cps.name: Chamonix (Start)
cps.desc: The Grand Depart. Runners funnel out through town before the first climb toward Les Houches.

cps.name: Les Houches
cps.desc: First water point, right after the initial climb out of Chamonix.

cps.name: Saint-Gervais
cps.desc: First food stop. Should still be relatively early/fresh here.

cps.name: Les Contamines
cps.desc: Official personal-assistance point. First place a supporter can meet the runner with gear, food, or a change of clothes.

cps.name: Les Chapieux
cps.desc: Hot meal stop after the long Col du Bonhomme / Croix du Bonhomme traverse.

cps.name: Lac Combal
cps.desc: After Col de la Seigne and the France/Italy border crossing.

cps.name: Checrouit
cps.desc: Water point on the descent toward Courmayeur.

cps.name: Courmayeur
cps.desc: Major life-base checkpoint with hot meal and official personal assistance. Common drop-bag and gear-change point.

cps.name: Refuge Bertone
cps.desc: Water point on the climb out of Courmayeur.

cps.name: Arnouvaz
cps.desc: Food stop before the climb to Grand Col Ferret and the Italy/Switzerland border.

cps.name: La Fouly
cps.desc: First Swiss aid station, after the Grand Col Ferret crossing.

cps.name: Champex-Lac
cps.desc: Major life-base checkpoint with hot meal and official personal assistance.

cps.name: Trient
cps.desc: Food stop before the climb back toward Catogne/Tete aux Vents.

cps.name: Vallorcine
cps.desc: Official personal-assistance point, last full supporter stop before the finish.

cps.name: La Flegere
cps.desc: Final water point before the last descent into Chamonix.
